name: gaming-device-licensing
description: Device enrollment, licensing, rebind limits, replay, and entitlement checks.
objectives: Assess device registration, account-device binding, rebind and revocation limits, signed challenges, replay resistance, and license refresh behavior.
Test trust boundaries around client-supplied device identifiers, clocks, caches, and offline licensing state.
Trace abuse chains across enrollment, license issuance, refresh, transfer, and revocation.
operational_constraints: Use designated test accounts and disposable test devices or VMs.
Do not invalidate real customer licenses or change production device bindings.
